items.t: Said he voted no on NAFTA because it would encourage companies to close Ohio factories and offshore jobs, and that he worked for more than a year to make the renegotiated agreement more pro-worker.
items.q: One of my proudest votes was against NAFTA, because I knew it would encourage multinational corporations to close factories in Ohio and offshore jobs to Mexico. The agreement President Trump negotiated wasn't much better, and I have spent more than a year working to make it more pro-worker.

items.t: Introduced the Stop Predatory Investing Act along with other Democratic senators.

items.t: Introduced the Yes In God’s Back Yard (YIGBY) Act, legislation to support faith-based organizations and colleges wanting to build and preserve affordable housing on their land.
